# Mample

Mample is a free Android mobile app and terminal CLI workflow for notifications when builds, scripts and AI coding tasks finish. Pair compatible mobile and CLI builds with mample auth --qr or manual Secret Key entry. No email/password registration is required; Firebase creates an anonymous session.

## Current scope
- No monthly notification quota, premium tier or subscription.
- Short-term request limits protect against spam.
- Terminal QR pairing is implemented in source: a single-use 90-second invitation leads to a connection without automatic expiry. Compatible mobile, CLI and backend releases are required; source implementation does not imply public package availability.
- Public mobile availability is shown in the website's release section.
- Browser extensions and browser download notifications are in development; existing code and demos are preserved on the separate extension page.
- Notification messages are temporarily queued in Firebase. The most recent 50 history entries are stored locally on the phone.
